rule: A task is done when its verify command exits 0 and its acceptance lines are all true. Frozen: once green, the verify command runs on every later commit.

tasks.title: Agent to pack map
acceptance: sources/agent-packs.json names all 15 agents
each entry lists pack skills and own skills separately
no agent is assigned a skill from a reference-mode pack

tasks.title: List installed packs
acceptance: prints pack id, license, source url and installed skill folders
reads the manifest, not the filesystem
exits 0 with a header even when nothing is installed

tasks.title: Remove a pack safely
acceptance: deletes only hash-matching files
keeps an edited file and names it
requires --write; without it, prints the plan and exits 2

tasks.title: Docs check covers sources and architecture
acceptance: a broken link in sources/ fails check.sh docs
a broken link in docs/architecture/ fails check.sh docs
no root is scanned twice

tasks.title: Two-OS CI matrix
acceptance: matrix lists ubuntu-latest and macos-latest
both jobs run check.sh all
the apps/ untouched check stays in both

tasks.title: Catalog rot probe
acceptance: re-checks every take path through the GitHub API
prints one line per pack
exits 1 on drift and names the pack

tasks.title: Apply the first five packs
acceptance: five packs installed into a workspace, named in sources/applied.json
each installed skill is reachable from at least one agent
agents outside the map are untouched

tasks.title: Proof packet
acceptance: check output, fixture transcript and commit sha in one file
file counts match the tree
written per skills/proof-packet
